entities.summary: Hunter Ryan Dickinson is an American professional basketball player for the New Orleans Pelicans of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Birmingham Squadron of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Michigan Wolverines and the Kansas Jayhawks.
